proposal.rationale: Chapter 38 is the Alabama Impaired Professionals' Committee chapter — it is scoped specifically to dentists, pharmacists, and hygienists under the Boards of Dental Examiners and Pharmacy (per the §34-38-1 definitions). It is NOT a universal occupational licensing chapter that applies to all Title 34 professions. Similarly, Section 16-67-1 is about a State Reciprocity Committee for higher education institutions, not occupational licensing at all. None of these 9 undetermined sections contain language asserting universal applicability across professions — they are all properly left undetermined for manual triage rather than falsely promoted to universal. Keeping the patterns conservative (generic safety-net universals only) is the correct call. Section cite pattern still captures the middle chapter token in 34-CHAP-SEC format.
